quote: On September 21, local time, the Espino Highway Project in Bolivia, which was constructed by CREC and participated by The First Engineering Bureau of CREC, China Railway Seventh Group Co., Ltd, China Railway No.9 Group Co., Ltd and China Railway International Group, was completed and opened to traffic… Located in the south of Santa Cruz… the Espino Highway Project is the core component of the passenger and freight dedicated line of the Bolivian Highway Network No.36
note: Opened CREC Espino Highway Bolivia opening primary (CapEx blank).
